cast.meridian_piglin.crossbow: A crossbow and a crossbow form are needed.
organ.meridian_piglin.gold_pouch.descrip: A pouch in the belly that stores gold nuggets.
codex.power.meridian_piglin.gold_eating_: Swallowed gold hardens the skin. A spare nugget makes a dart.
Iron softens beneath the palm. A body cast in gold withstands fire.
effect.meridian_piglin.feeding.descripti: Gold crunches between the teeth as the lungs grow warm.
effect.meridian_piglin.gilded.descriptio: A blade skates across the skin. A pick bites deep.
effect.meridian_piglin.midased.descripti: Soft gold spreads from the palm print across plate and cutting edge.
effect.meridian_piglin.gold_cast.descrip: The feet sink into the earth as the body sets into gold.
